method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited Act and Regulations with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; one question module (sacat-applicant.l4), one date module on built-in date functions (sacat-dates.l4), one case file; answers are named outcomes, dates and numbers, no MAYBE BOOLEAN, so no NOTHING-kind tags; three regulative rules (s 35(2) with r 6, s 70(2), s 71(3)) run inside questions with EVALTRACE; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: South Australian Civil and Administrative Tribunal Act 2013 (SA), register version 1.6.2025, and South Australian Civil and Administrative Tribunal Regulations 2015, register version 1.7.2020, both fetched from www.legislation.sa.gov.au on 2026-11-06 (unauthorised RTF; not the Open Australian Legal Corpus), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/south-australian-civil-and-administrative-tribunal-act-2013.txt (text sha256 75447e495f03563366eef34ad10b8ed04a4ec7423c5ecac463035d6c849fd3e9) and ../../../south-australian-civil-and-administrative-tribunal-regulations-2015/registers/source-bundle/south-australian-civil-and-administrative-tribunal-regulations-2015.txt (text sha256 09dcf96641f62a901b54a51bf70e8fd49ed4778f05c4971efa6b9a49ba158448). The SACAT Rules, the Magistrates Court Act 1991 limit, the Supreme Court Rules, the relevant Acts and the Legislation Interpretation Act 2021 are not deposited: inputs or forks.

seat: the applicant: the person who brings a claim or other matter before the South Australian Civil and Administrative Tribunal, or asks it to review a decision made about them, and goes on to internal review, appeal or enforcement (sacat-applicant.l4)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run sacat-dates.l4 ; l4 run sacat-applicant.l4 ; l4 run sacat-cases-applicant.l4
checks.result: 221 assertions written, 221 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07, after the fix for the independent verification); negative controls (r 6 rule WITHIN 20 and s 47(4) dropped from r 11: the 3 predicted failures; the r 6 days constant made 20: the 5 predicted failures) were reverted
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.
